sudoku.interpretation: Positive same-digit pair support exactly recovers row/column/box conflicts, but the raw learned energy also has weak negative same-digit costs on non-conflicting pairs and nonuniform positive magnitudes. It is not an exact uniform hand-set Sudoku energy.

maze_unique.interpretation: For a free cell, the binary field is E(on)-E(off). Negative prefers on. Center in the display is the interior intercept, not a self-coupling. Exact affine expansion is checked against the source field on all local binary configurations at interior, edge, and corner locations.
maze_unique.boundary_scope: All benchmark boundary cells are clamped walls, so every free cell has the complete 3x3 window. The 64 synthetic boundary disagreements concern out-of-benchmark free boundary cells; the applicable interior rule matches all 256 binary neighborhoods.
